codec.endpoint_nonfinite_saturation_roundtrip_: FAIL whole qualification/request; no clipping, discard, repair or atoms
codec.global_refresh_contract: decode first; exact G3 replaces only physical0:3 and keeps physical3:21 byte-identical
codec.input_dtype: original saved Float64 physical; no implicit conversion
codec.model_cast: one final Float32 cast of Float64 latent coordinates
codec.normal_prior_scope: ideal real-arithmetic prior only; no posterior normality or accuracy guarantee

tolerances.F64_latent_scope: declared conditioning/roundtrip admissibility; NOT an ulp-Float64 accuracy guarantee

neural_policy.native_stage_rule: new explicit all8 originalFP32 ordered stages6/10/14 only

probability_policy.CDF_resolution: positive raw weights can naturally collapse in F64 CDF differences; counts/masses reported, no threshold zeroing
probability_policy.borders: promote original fitted FP32 bits; do not recompute target scaling in F64
probability_policy.head_acceptance: EXACT e71 function; raw translated F64 mass BEFORE normalization
probability_policy.inverse: softmax64(log RAW weights); cumsum(apiP)/terminal; invert represented positive CDF intervals
probability_policy.neural_input: actual translator-entry FP32 logits, already temperature/cancel adjusted; no second temperature
probability_policy.positive_uniform_ties: left search; zero-width represented CDF intervals never selected
probability_policy.source_CDF_order: softmax64; cumsum(p)-p; corrected share; source boundary/share/CDF clamps; diff; negative-source-diff clamp_min0
probability_policy.uniform_domain: original CPU torch.float32 [0,1); promoted unchanged to F64; u=1 rejected
probability_policy.zero_uniform: u=0 selects first represented positive interval left border; NEW finite-support extension, not legacy NaN
